newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - RBA fills assistant governor post internally.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - RBA fills assistant governor post internally.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia said Monday it had appointed Glenn Stevens to the position of Assistant Governor (Economic) which became vacant when Stephen Grenville was made Deputy Governor.
Stevens was formerly head of the International Department at the RBA, the central bank said in a statement.
That post will now be filled by Bob Rankin, formerly head of the Domestic Markets Department, whose position will be taken by Frank Campbell, who has headed the Economic Analysis Department.
